detail.longDescription: If you work remotely across time zones, the mental overhead of converting times adds up. I added world clocks to my Firefox new tab with Weather & Clock Dashboard — now every new tab shows me what time it is in London and Singapore without me having to think about it. Wrote about the full setup for async remote work: https:// dev.to/weatherclockdash/remote -work-across-time-zones-the-browser-setup-that-keeps-you-oriented-3j18 # RemoteWork # Productivity # Firefox
